attempted_axis: Exact closure of PlayerCollidePlayers' whole-function FPR/GPR colour permutation: chained-init constant ownership, same-type and cross-type declaration order, f64 retyping, C89 declaration hoist, shared Player* web for the loop base and the tail record, and finally pool-literal vs extern spelling for the loop-invariant 0.0f.

attributes.axis_log: AXIS1 decl-init copy `f32 dotFloor = best;` NEUTRAL (MWCC folds it to two independent CSE'd loads, identical bytes to the two-separate-initializer baseline). AXIS2 chained statement `dotFloor = best = lbl_80347B30;` IMPROVED real 32 -> 28: the chained-init law's inner variable took ownership of the pool load, moving `best` to f31 and fixing its whole web. AXIS3 same chain with declaration order swapped (dotFloor before best) REGRESSED 28 -> 34: same-type declaration order does matter and best-first is correct. AXIS4 split statements `best = lbl; dotFloor = best;` REGRESSED to 32. AXIS5 shared `Player* op` web hoisted to function scope and reused for both the loop element and the tail `cp` IMPROVED 28 -> 20 and closed the GPR half outright (target reuses r27 for the tail record; a separate block-scoped `cp` took r26). AXIS6 moving `dotFloor`'s declaration across a different-typed declaration NEUTRAL. AXIS7 retyping `dotFloor` to f64 NEUTRAL. AXIS8 full C89 declaration hoist of dot/d/ex/ez/dist/scale to function scope NEUTRAL - block scope and declaration placement are invisible to MWCC's web ordering, which killed the whole declaration-shuffling family. AXIS9 replacing the guard variable with a direct extern read `if (dot < lbl_80347B30)` REGRESSED 20 -> 54 and inserted an extra in-loop lfs, proving MWCC will NOT hoist a mutable extern read across the loop's calls. AXIS10 pool-literal substitution `f32 best = 0.0f` + `if (dot < 0.0f)` reached real 0 once the TAIL site was left as the extern: substituting the tail's `lbl_80347B30 * scale` too made MWCC constant-fold the multiply away (124 -> 122 instructions, target-only +1 lfs +1 fmadds), so that one site must keep the extern spelling.

attributes.semantic_audit: Behaviour is unchanged: the guard constant, the nearest-player selection, the LineCylinderCollide/fqdist calls, the stopFirst break and the push-out arithmetic are all identical. lbl_80347B30 was confirmed via tools/gdl/poolval.py to be .sdata2, f32, bytes 00 00 00 00 = 0.0f, so the literal `0.0f` is bit-identical to the extern read and satisfies claim.law.pool-literal-sweep-section-and-lvalue-preconditions (read-only section, no address-taken/lvalue use, exact round-trip). The shared `op` pointer replaces a block-scoped `cp` with the same value &gPlayerRecords[closest].
